Class RMIServerConnection

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.network.client.RMIServerConnection
All Implemented Interfaces:
ServerConnection, SmallModelNotifier, Serializable, Remote
public class RMIServerConnection extends UnicastRemoteObject implements ServerConnection
Client-side component handling the RMI connection to the server. It sends local player commands to the server and receives game state updates.
